scope: Curated historical release and method-event examples, not a complete release calendar. Official facts checked against primary pages; corpus timestamps remain metadata, not independently authenticated publisher times.

events.title: BEA: Q2 2021 GDP advance estimate
events.facts: Real GDP grew 6.5% quarter over quarter at an annualized rate; an advance estimate, not a year-over-year rate.

members.summary: ABC emphasizes solid quarterly growth of 6.5%.
Reuters emphasizes solid growth alongside falling weekly jobless claims.
Reuters commentary emphasizes supply constraints alongside solid growth.

events.exclusions: The same-day historical pandemic-recession revision concerns a different period; commentary is excluded from the straight-news pair.

events.title: BEA: July 2022 personal income and outlays
events.facts: Headline PCE prices rose 6.3% year over year and fell 0.1% from the previous month; contemporaneous release values.

events.title: Federal Reserve: Jackson Hole monetary-policy speech
events.facts: The speech discussed restrictive policy and the costs of restoring price stability. Its coincidence with the PCE release cautions against treating all same-day headlines as one event.

events.title: BLS: May 2023 Employment Situation
events.facts: Payrolls rose 339,000 while unemployment rose 0.3 percentage point to 3.7%; these come from different surveys in the same release.

members.summary: ABC emphasizes robust payroll growth despite rate increases.
Bloomberg combines payroll growth with rising unemployment.

events.exclusions: The truncated CNBC headline is not used to infer its substantive framing.

events.title: Michigan survey begins transition to web collection
events.facts: April–July 2024 transition; month precision is intentional. This is a comparability marker, not an estimated treatment effect.

events.title: BEA: March 2024 personal income and outlays
events.facts: Headline PCE inflation was 2.7% year over year, up from 2.5%; core inflation was 2.8% year over year and 0.3% month over month.

members.summary: Bloomberg emphasizes the pace of the core inflation measure.
CNN emphasizes deterioration in the preferred inflation gauge.

events.exclusions: Matching the release does not equate headline and core inflation; different factual facets remain a confounder.

events.title: Michigan survey completes transition to web collection
events.facts: Completion month for the fixed ramp control; not evidence that the transition caused the index decline.

events.title: BEA: Q4 and full-year 2024 GDP advance estimate
events.facts: Real GDP grew 2.3% QoQ annualized in Q4 and 2.8% for the full year; the two rate conventions are distinct.
